comment:
* BasicChecker is a PKIXCertPathChecker that checks the basic information
 * on a PKIX certificate, namely the signature, timestamp, and subject/issuer
 * name chaining.
 *
 * @since       1.4
 * @author      Yassir Elley

methods.name: public void init(boolean forward) throws CertPathValidatorException
methods.comment:
* Initializes the internal state of the checker from parameters
     * specified in the constructor.

methods.name: public void check(Certificate cert, Collection<String> unresolvedCritExts) throws CertPathValidatorException
methods.comment:
* Performs the signature, timestamp, and subject/issuer name chaining
     * checks on the certificate using its internal state. This method does
     * not remove any critical extensions from the Collection.
     *
     * @param cert the Certificate
     * @param unresolvedCritExts a Collection of the unresolved critical
     * extensions
     * @throws CertPathValidatorException if certificate does not verify

methods.name: private void verifySignature(X509Certificate cert) throws CertPathValidatorException
methods.comment:
* Verifies the signature on the certificate using the previous public key.
     *
     * @param cert the X509Certificate
     * @throws CertPathValidatorException if certificate does not verify

methods.name: private void verifyTimestamp(X509Certificate cert) throws CertPathValidatorException
methods.comment: * Internal method to verify the timestamp on a certificate

methods.name: private void verifyNameChaining(X509Certificate cert) throws CertPathValidatorException
methods.comment: * Internal method to check that cert has a valid DN to be next in a chain

methods.name: private void updateState(X509Certificate currCert) throws CertPathValidatorException
methods.comment: * Internal method to manage state information at each iteration

methods.name: static PublicKey makeInheritedParamsKey(PublicKey keyValueKey, PublicKey keyParamsKey) throws CertPathValidatorException
methods.comment:
* Internal method to create a new key with inherited key parameters.
     *
     * @param keyValueKey key from which to obtain key value
     * @param keyParamsKey key from which to obtain key parameters
     * @return new public key having value and parameters
     * @throws CertPathValidatorException if keys are not appropriate types
     * for this operation

methods.name: PublicKey getPublicKey()
methods.comment:
* return the public key associated with the last certificate processed
     *
     * @return PublicKey the last public key processed

methodNames: public void init(boolean forward) throws CertPathValidatorException
public void check(Certificate cert, Collection<String> unresolvedCritExts) throws CertPathValidatorException
private void verifySignature(X509Certificate cert) throws CertPathValidatorException
private void verifyTimestamp(X509Certificate cert) throws CertPathValidatorException
private void verifyNameChaining(X509Certificate cert) throws CertPathValidatorException
private void updateState(X509Certificate currCert) throws CertPathValidatorException
static PublicKey makeInheritedParamsKey(PublicKey keyValueKey, PublicKey keyParamsKey) throws CertPathValidatorException
